findings.explanation: Your indemnification obligations under Section 9 are excluded from the liability cap and have no separate limit, exposing you to unlimited financial risk for third-party claims.
findings.suggested_change: Except for intellectual property indemnification obligations, which shall be subject to a separate aggregate cap, the total liability of either party under this Agreement shall not exceed fifteen million dollars.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a quick adjustment before we sign: - Regarding the relevant clause, the indemnification obligations under Section 9 are excluded from the liability cap, which leaves no separate limit and creates open financial exposure. I suggest updating this so that except for intellectual property indemnification obligations, which shall be subject to a separate aggregate cap, the total liability of either party under the agreement shall not exceed fifteen million dollars. Thank you for your flexibility and understanding.
